# RIV

The objective is to detect pattern or trend in the recruitment of the patient

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(CptPointProcess)
library(rivpipeline)
rkd_file <- "C:/Users/COQM/OneDrive - Trinity College Dublin/Redcap Data exports/RareKidneyDiseaseRIT-PARADISE_DATA_LABELS_2026-10-01_1148.csv"
rkd <- read.csv(rkd_file,header=T)
output_dir <- tempdir()
split_RKD <- SplitRIV(rkd, output_dir)
Inclusion_Criteria_rkd <- FilterRIV(split_RKD$Initial, tempdir(),c("Definite MPA", "Definite GPA"))

rkd_filter <- Inclusion_Criteria_rkd[,c("RKD.ID", "Gender", "Age.at.diagnosis", "Date.of.diagnosis", "Date.of.Initial.Consent", "Small.vessel.vasculitis..ANCA.associated.", "At.any.point.ANCA.specificity")]

rkd_filter$Date.of.diagnosis=as.Date(rkd_filter$Date.of.diagnosis)
rkd_filter$Date.of.Initial.Consent=as.Date(rkd_filter$Date.of.Initial.Consent)

rkd_selected=rkd_filter[which(rkd_filter$Date.of.diagnosis>=as.Date("2013-01-01") & rkd_filter$Date.of.diagnosis<as.Date("2024-04-01")),]

rkd_selected=rkd_selected[order(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis),]

rkd_selected$type.of.recruitment = NULL
for (i in 1:nrow(rkd_selected)){
  if(is.na(rkd_selected$Date.of.Initial.Consent[i])==F){
    if(abs(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis[i] - rkd_selected$Date.of.Initial.Consent[i])>30 ){
    rkd_selected$type.of.recruitment[i]="retrospective"
  }else{
    rkd_selected$type.of.recruitment[i]="prospective"
  }
  }
  
}



library(lubridate)

barplot(table(day(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),main="Distribution of days")

barplot(table(month(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),main="Distribution of months")

barplot(table(year(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),main="Distribution of years")

barplot(table(rkd_selected$type.of.recruitment,day(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),col=rainbow(2))

barplot(table(rkd_selected$type.of.recruitment,year(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),col=rainbow(2))

rkd_selected=rkd_selected[which(rkd_selected$type.of.recruitment == "prospective"),]

png("RIV cohort plot.png", width = 6, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 3000)
plot(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis,1:length(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis),type='s',ylab="", xlab="Date of Diagnosis")
dev.off()
```

The above graphics shows the inclusion rate.

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
rkd_selected$Interval_in_day=as.numeric(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis-rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis[1])

for (i in 1:335){
  if (rkd_selected$Small.vessel.vasculitis..ANCA.associated.[i]=="Microscopic polyangiitis (including renal limited vasculitis) - ORPHA:727"){
    rkd_selected$Small.vessel.vasculitis..ANCA.associated.[i]="MPA"
  }else{
    rkd_selected$Small.vessel.vasculitis..ANCA.associated.[i]="GPA"
  }
}

```

## Interval from the first day

```{r}
library(lubridate)
#generate and store 1000 CDFs using simulation method
rkd_selected$Interval=c(0,diff(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day))
B<- 1000 
n <- length(rkd_selected$Interval)

y1 <- ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval)
q1 <- quantile(y1, rep(0:10)/10)
q1[which.max(q1)] <- 1e6
q1 <- unique(round(q1))
tab1 <- table(cut(rkd_selected$Interval, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))

# xseq <- seq(0, max(rkd_selected$Interval), len = 100)
prop_imp <- round((0.407 - 12/365)*n)

rate_est <- 1/mean(rkd_selected$Interval)
nsim <- length(rkd_selected$Interval)
boot_mat <- matrix(0, nrow=nsim, ncol = 1000)
pvalue=NULL
resi=NULL
y_imp_mat <- matrix(0, nrow=nsim, ncol = 1000)
for(b in 1:B){
  # boot_samp <- sample(1:n, replace=TRUE)
  # yboot <- rkd_selected$Interval[boot_samp]
  # rate_boot <- 1/mean(yboot)
  boot_mat[, b] <- rexp(nsim, rate = rate_est)
  ysim <- round(boot_mat[, b])
  
  y_imp_mat[,b] <- ysim
  exp_sim <- table(cut(ysim, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))/length(ysim)
  c1 <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim)

  resi=rbind(resi, c1$stdres)
  pvalue=c(pvalue, c1$p.value)
}

plot(ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = 0, ylab="P(t < T)", main = "Cumulative distribution of days between diagnosis events", cex.main=0.7, do.points = FALSE)
for(b in 1:B) lines(ecdf(round(y_imp_mat[, b])), col = 3, do.points=FALSE)
lines (ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = "blue")

boxplot(pvalue,main="distribution of the p-value of the Chi-squared test",outline=F)
boxplot(resi, main= "distribution of the residual error of the Chi-squared test", outline=F)

plot(ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = 0,xlab="Days", ylab="P(t < T)", main = "Cumulative distribution of days between diagnosis events", cex.main=0.7, do.points = FALSE,xlim=c(0,100))
for(b in 1:B) lines(ecdf(round(boot_mat[, b])), col = 3, do.points=FALSE)
lines (ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = "blue")

exp_sim_total <- table(cut(y_imp_mat, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))/length(y_imp_mat)
print(exp_sim_total)
print(tab1)
c1_overall <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim_total)
saveRDS(c1_overall, file="Skane Chisq test")
print(c1_overall$p.value)
print(c1_overall)
barplot(c1_overall$stdres, main = "Chi-squared test residuals")
```

The 2 graphics above show the distribution of the interval of time. 
A changepoint model based on Poisson process is applied to find cluster of inclusion rate. 

```{r}
dat=as.data.frame(cbind((rkd_selected$Interval_in_day+1)/(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2), 1:length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)))
colnames(dat)=c("times", "marks")
Res.Seg=CptPointProcess(dat, Kmax=10, selection = F)
plot(Res.Seg$Contrast + (1:10)*log(nrow(dat))) ## use BIC because cross-validation breaks for these data 


Res.Seg=CptPointProcess(dat, Kmax=3, selection = F)
Res.Seg$SegK

png("RIV changepoint plot.png", width = 6, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 3000)
graphics::par(new=FALSE)
plot(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis,1:length(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis),type='s',ylab="Number of patient included", xlab="Date of Diagnosis")
points(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis, rep(0,length(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)),pch=20)
if (nrow(Res.Seg$SegK)!=1){
  graphics::abline(v=as.Date(Res.Seg$SegK$end*3969,min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis))[1:(length(as.Date(Res.Seg$SegK$end*3969,min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)))-1)], col=2, lty=2)
}

graphics:: par(new=TRUE)
graphics::plot(0, xlim=c(min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis), max(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)), ylim=c(0, 60), col=0,
               xlab=NA, ylab=NA, main=NA, axes=FALSE)
for(k in 1:nrow(Res.Seg$SegK)){
  graphics::lines(c(as.Date(Res.Seg$SegK$begin[k]*3969,min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis)), as.Date(Res.Seg$SegK$end[k]*3969,min(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis))), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda[k]*365/3969)*c(1, 1), col=2, lwd=2)
}
graphics::axis(side=4, col=2, col.ticks=2, col.axis=2)
mtext("rate per year", side=4,col=2,line=-1)
dev.off()
```

The graphics above shows us that there is one change point at 64% of the timeline. This changepoint is on September 2019, few month before Covid19 hit Ireland. The inclusion rate pass from 1 patient every 7 days to 1 patient every 15 days.

```{r}
tau <- Res.Seg$SegK$end[-3]*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)-1
tseq <- 1:max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)

lambda1 <- (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[1]
lambda2 <- (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[2]
lambda3 <- (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[3]

sel2 <- tseq>=tau[1] & tseq<tau[2]
sel3 <- tseq>=tau[2]

tseq1 <- tseq[sel1]
tseq2 <- tseq[sel2]
tseq3 <- tseq[sel3]

lambda1_star <- lambda1*max(tseq1)
tstar2 <- min(tseq2) + 1
tstar3 <- min(tseq3) + 1

lambda2_star <- lambda1_star + lambda2*max(tseq2 - tstar2)

plot(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day,1:length(rkd_selected$Date.of.diagnosis),type='s',col=1, lwd=3, main = "RIV data", ylab = "Number of events", xlab = "Interval (days)")

abline(v=tau, col="red")

lines(tseq, c(lambda1*tseq1, lambda1_star + lambda2*(tseq2 - tstar2), lambda2_star +  lambda3*(tseq3 - tstar3)), lwd=1, col = 3)



```


The modelisation of the changepoint model through a exponential distribution works well.

## Interval between diagnosis date

We calculate the interval in days between the a diagnosis data and the following one.

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
rkd_selected$Interval=c(0,diff(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day))

```







```{r}
dat=as.data.frame(cbind((rkd_selected$Interval_in_day+1)/(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2), 1:length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)))
colnames(dat)=c("times", "marks")
Res.Seg=CptPointProcess(dat, Kmax=10, selection = T)
SegK <- Res.Seg$SegK

K <- length(SegK$end)
tau_vec <- c(0, SegK$end)*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)
tau_vec[K+1] <- tau_vec[K+1] - 2
# tau <- Res.Seg$SegK$end[1]*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)-1
n = length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)

# tsim <- rep(0, n)
simChDat <- function(SegK){
  K <- length(SegK$lambda)
  x0 <- 0
  for(k in 1:K){
    # sel_1 <- rkd_selected$Interval_in_day >= tau_vec[k]
    # sel_2 <- rkd_selected$Interval_in_day < tau_vec[k+1]
    # nk <- sum(sel_1 & sel_2)
    # tsim1 <- rexp(n, (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[1])  
    daily_lambda_k <- SegK$lambda[k] / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day))
    tsim <- rexp(n, daily_lambda_k)
    sel <- (cumsum(tsim) + max(x0)) < tau_vec[k+1]
    x0 = c(x0, max(x0) + cumsum(tsim[sel]))
  }
  # x0 <- x0[-1]
  
  # plot(y = 1:length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day), x = x0, type="s", lwd = 1,xlab="Interval in day", ylab="")
  # abline(v=tau_vec, col="red")
  x0
}

x0 <- simChDat(SegK)

nsim <- length(x0)

x0mat <- replicate(1000, simChDat(SegK))
x0 <- x0mat[[1]]
nsim <- length(x0)
plot(ecdf(round(diff(x0))), lwd = 1,xlab="Days", ylab="P(t < T)", col = 3, main = "Cumulative distribution of days between diagnosis events", cex.main=0.7, do.points = FALSE)
#abline(v=tau_vec, col="red")
test2=quantile(ecdf(round(diff(x0))),seq(0,1,0.1))
for(i in 2:1000){
  
  # tau <- Res.Seg$SegK$end[1]*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)-1
  # n = length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)
  # tsim1 <- rexp(length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[1])
  # x = cumsum(tsim1)
  # x <- x[x< tau]
  # tsim2 <- rexp(n - length(x), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[2])
  # x <- c(x, max(x) + cumsum(tsim2))
  # lines(y = 1:n, x = x, type="s", col = 3)
  
  x0 <- x0mat[[i]]
  nsim <- length(x0)
  lines(ecdf(round(diff(x0))), col = 3, do.points = FALSE)
  test2=rbind(test2,quantile(ecdf(round(diff(x0))),seq(0,1,0.1)))
}
test3=colMeans(test2)
lines(ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval),col=1)
```

# IDIBELL

The objective is to detect pattern or trend in the recruitment of the patient

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(CptPointProcess)
library(IDIBELLpipeline)
idibell_file <- "C:/Users/COQM/OneDrive - Trinity College Dublin/THKC - Matthieu Coq/Paradise data shared/Barcelona data/202133REGISTREVASCUL-PARADISEIdibellAllVa_DATA_LABELS_2024-04-30_1203.csv"
idibell <- load_IDIBELL(idibell_file)
split_idibell <- SplitIDIBELL(idibell, tempdir())

rkd_filter <- split_idibell$Initial[which(split_idibell$Initial$X.Diagnosis.confidence..initial.assessment..=="Definite" & split_idibell$Initial$X.Small.vessel.vasculitis..ANCA.associated.. != "Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (Churg Strauss) - ORPHA:183"),]

rkd_filter$date_of_diagnosis=as.Date(rkd_filter$X.Date.of.diagnosis..required.for.planning.treatment.)

rkd_selected=rkd_filter[which(rkd_filter$date_of_diagnosis>=as.Date("2013-01-01")),]

rkd_selected=rkd_selected[order(rkd_selected$date_of_diagnosis),]
rkd_selected$X.Date.of.enrolment.=as.Date(rkd_selected$X.Date.of.enrolment.)
rkd_selected$type.of.recruitment = NULL
for (i in 1:nrow(rkd_selected)){
  if(is.na(rkd_selected$X.Date.of.enrolment.[i])==F){
    if(abs(rkd_selected$date_of_diagnosis[i] - rkd_selected$X.Date.of.enrolment.[i])>30 ){
    rkd_selected$type.of.recruitment[i]="retrospective"
  }else{
    rkd_selected$type.of.recruitment[i]="prospective"
  }
  }
  
}


png("IDIBELL cohort plot.png", width = 6, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 3000)
plot(rkd_selected$date_of_diagnosis,1:length(rkd_selected$date_of_diagnosis),type='s',ylab="", xlab="Date of Diagnosis")
dev.off()

rkd_selected$Interval_in_day=as.numeric(rkd_selected$date_of_diagnosis-rkd_selected$date_of_diagnosis[1])


library(lubridate)

barplot(table(day(rkd_selected$date_of_diagnosis)),main="Distribution of days")

barplot(table(month(rkd_selected$date_of_diagnosis)),main="Distribution of months")

barplot(table(year(rkd_selected$date_of_diagnosis)),main="Distribution of years")


```

The graphic above show the evolution of the diagnosis over time since 2013.

```{r}
rkd_selected$Interval=c(0,diff(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day))
B<- 1000 
n <- length(rkd_selected$Interval)

##generate and store 1000 CDFs using bootstrap method

boot_mat <- matrix(0, nrow=100, ncol = 1000)
xseq <- seq(0, max(rkd_selected$Interval), len = 100)

for(b in 1:B){
  boot_samp <- sample(1:n, replace=TRUE)
  yboot <- rkd_selected$Interval[boot_samp]
  rate_boot <- 1/mean(yboot)
  
  boot_mat[, b] <- pexp(xseq, rate = rate_boot)
  }

plot(ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = 0)
for(b in 1:B) lines(xseq, boot_mat[, b], col = "lightgray")
lines (ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = "red")

q1 <- quantile(y1, rep(0:10)/10)
q1[which.max(q1)] <- 1e6
q1 <- unique(round(q1))
tab1 <- table(cut(rkd_selected$Interval, breaks = q1, include.lowest = TRUE))/length(rkd_selected$Interval)
ysim <- round(boot_mat)
exp_sim <- table(cut(ysim, breaks = q1, include.lowest = TRUE))/length(ysim)
c1 <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim)
print(c1)
```



```{r}
library(lubridate)
#generate and store 1000 CDFs using simulation method
rkd_selected$Interval=c(0,diff(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day))
B<- 1000 
n <- length(rkd_selected$Interval)

y1 <- ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval)
q1 <- quantile(y1, rep(0:10)/10)
q1[which.max(q1)] <- 1e6
q1 <- unique(round(q1))
tab1 <- table(cut(rkd_selected$Interval, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))

# xseq <- seq(0, max(rkd_selected$Interval), len = 100)
prop_imp <- round((0.407 - 12/365)*n)

rate_est <- 1/mean(rkd_selected$Interval)
nsim <- length(rkd_selected$Interval)
boot_mat <- matrix(0, nrow=nsim, ncol = 1000)
pvalue=NULL
resi=NULL
y_imp_mat <- matrix(0, nrow=nsim, ncol = 1000)
for(b in 1:B){
  # boot_samp <- sample(1:n, replace=TRUE)
  # yboot <- rkd_selected$Interval[boot_samp]
  # rate_boot <- 1/mean(yboot)
  boot_mat[, b] <- rexp(nsim, rate = rate_est)
  ysim <- round(boot_mat[, b])
  
  y_imp_mat[,b] <- ysim
  exp_sim <- table(cut(ysim, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))/length(ysim)
  c1 <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim)

  resi=rbind(resi, c1$stdres)
  pvalue=c(pvalue, c1$p.value)
}
png("Norwich plot.png", width = 6, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 3000)
plot(ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = 0, ylab="P(t < T)", xlab="Days", main = "Cumulative distribution of days between diagnosis events", cex.main=0.7, do.points = FALSE)
for(b in 1:B) lines(ecdf(round(y_imp_mat[, b])), col = "gray", do.points=FALSE)
lines (ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = "black")
dev.off()
boxplot(pvalue,main="distribution of the p-value of the Chi-squared test",outline=F)
boxplot(resi, main= "distribution of the residual error of the Chi-squared test", outline=F)

plot(ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = 0,xlab="Days", ylab="P(t < T)", main = "Cumulative distribution of days between diagnosis events", cex.main=0.7, do.points = FALSE,xlim=c(0,100))
for(b in 1:B) lines(ecdf(round(boot_mat[, b])), col = 3, do.points=FALSE)
lines (ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval), col = "blue")

exp_sim_total <- table(cut(y_imp_mat, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))/length(y_imp_mat)
print(exp_sim_total)
print(tab1)
c1_overall <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim_total)
saveRDS(c1_overall, file="Skane Chisq test")
print(c1_overall$p.value)
print(c1_overall)
barplot(c1_overall$stdres, main = "Chi-squared test residuals")
```

```{r}
Res.Seg=CptPointProcess(dat, Kmax=10, selection = T)
SegK <- Res.Seg$SegK

K <- length(SegK$end)
tau_vec <- c(0, SegK$end)*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)
tau_vec[K+1] <- tau_vec[K+1] - 2
# tau <- Res.Seg$SegK$end[1]*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)-1
n = length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)

# tsim <- rep(0, n)
simChDat <- function(SegK){
  K <- length(SegK$lambda)
  x0 <- 0
  for(k in 1:K){
    # sel_1 <- rkd_selected$Interval_in_day >= tau_vec[k]
    # sel_2 <- rkd_selected$Interval_in_day < tau_vec[k+1]
    # nk <- sum(sel_1 & sel_2)
    # tsim1 <- rexp(n, (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[1])  
    daily_lambda_k <- SegK$lambda[k] / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day))
    tsim <- rexp(n, daily_lambda_k)
    sel <- (cumsum(tsim) + max(x0)) < tau_vec[k+1]
    x0 = c(x0, max(x0) + cumsum(tsim[sel]))
  }
  # x0 <- x0[-1]
  
  # plot(y = 1:length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day), x = x0, type="s", lwd = 1,xlab="Interval in day", ylab="")
  # abline(v=tau_vec, col="red")
  x0
}
```

```{r}
Res.Seg=CptPointProcess(dat, Kmax=10, selection = T)
SegK <- Res.Seg$SegK

K <- length(SegK$end)
tau_vec <- c(0, SegK$end)*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)
tau_vec[K+1] <- tau_vec[K+1] - 2
# tau <- Res.Seg$SegK$end[1]*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)-1
n = length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)

# tsim <- rep(0, n)
simChDat <- function(SegK){
  K <- length(SegK$lambda)
  x0 <- 0
  for(k in 1:K){
    # sel_1 <- rkd_selected$Interval_in_day >= tau_vec[k]
    # sel_2 <- rkd_selected$Interval_in_day < tau_vec[k+1]
    # nk <- sum(sel_1 & sel_2)
    # tsim1 <- rexp(n, (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[1])  
    daily_lambda_k <- SegK$lambda[k] / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day))
    tsim <- rexp(n, daily_lambda_k)
    sel <- (cumsum(tsim) + max(x0)) < tau_vec[k+1]
    x0 = c(x0, max(x0) + cumsum(tsim[sel]))
  }
  # x0 <- x0[-1]
  
  # plot(y = 1:length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day), x = x0, type="s", lwd = 1,xlab="Interval in day", ylab="")
  # abline(v=tau_vec, col="red")
  x0
}

x0 <- simChDat(SegK)

y1 <- ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval)
q1 <- quantile(y1, rep(0:10)/10)
q1[which.max(q1)] <- 1e6
q1 <- unique(round(q1))
tab1 <- table(cut(rkd_selected$Interval, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))

nsim <- length(x0)
prop_imp <- round((0.223 - 12/365)*n)
x0mat <- replicate(1000, simChDat(SegK))
x0 <- x0mat[[1]]
nsim <- length(x0)
png("UKIVAS plot.png", width = 6, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 3000)
plot(ecdf(diff(x0)), lwd = 1,xlab="Days", ylab="P(t < T)", col = 0, main = "Cumulative distribution of days between diagnosis events", cex.main=0.7, do.points = FALSE)
#abline(v=tau_vec, col="red")
resi=NULL
pvalue=NULL
ysim <- round(diff(x0))
exp_sim_total=table(cut(ysim, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))
for(i in 2:1000){
  
  # tau <- Res.Seg$SegK$end[1]*(max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2)-1
  # n = length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)
  # tsim1 <- rexp(length(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[1])
  # x = cumsum(tsim1)
  # x <- x[x< tau]
  # tsim2 <- rexp(n - length(x), (Res.Seg$SegK$lambda / (max(rkd_selected$Interval_in_day)+2))[2])
  # x <- c(x, max(x) + cumsum(tsim2))
  # lines(y = 1:n, x = x, type="s", col = 3)
  
  x0 <- x0mat[[i]]
  nsim <- length(x0)
  
  
  lines(ecdf(diff(x0)), col = "gray", do.points = FALSE)
  
  ysim <- round(diff(x0))
  y0 <- ysim
  x0 <- as.Date(cumsum(c(0, y0)), origin = "2012-09-01")
    s1 <- sample(1:nsim, size = prop_imp) 
  mday(x0)[s1] <- 1
  y1 <- as.numeric(x0) - as.numeric(as.Date(0, origin = "2012-09-01"))
  y1 <- sort(y1)
  y1 <- diff(y1)
  
  exp_sim <- table(cut(ysim, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))/length(ysim)
  c1 <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim)
  resi=rbind(resi, c1$stdres)
  pvalue=c(pvalue, c1$p.value)
   exp_sim_total=exp_sim_total+table(cut(ysim, breaks = c(0,3,7,14,21,1e6), include.lowest = TRUE))
}

lines(ecdf(rkd_selected$Interval),col=1)
dev.off()

boxplot(pvalue,main="distribution of the p-value of the Chi-squared test",outline=F)
boxplot(resi, main= "distribution of the residual error of the Chi-squared test", outline=F)

exp_sim_total=exp_sim_total/sum(exp_sim_total)
print(exp_sim_total)
print(tab1)
c1_overall <- chisq.test(tab1, p = exp_sim_total)
saveRDS(c1_overall, file="UKIVAS Chisq test")
print(c1_overall$p.value)
barplot(c1_overall$stdres, main = "Chi-squared test residuals")
```
